body:
[A171 / A10] Prove bounded replay of one redundant merge while refusing unproved current retention. Git filename bytes are preserved across filesystem encodings in both existing checks and the new fallback.

Closes #423

## Description

The final fallback requires the settled exact two-parent shape, distinct whitespace-exact replay commits with matching postimages, and current raw entry retention or an exact no-op three-way blob merge. Missing work, resolution changes and unproved later reversions remain nonzero. The existing linear historical policy stays with #514; actual gPTP processor PR62 remains UNKNOWN. No PP (protocol processor) or gPTP processor pin changes.

The shared Git decoder, patch inverse and retention filename checks use a reversible filesystem encoding pair. The default selftest owns actual UTF-8, ASCII and Latin-1 process controls with raw names, aliases, positive and negative histories, entry/postimage/patch checks and explicit unavailable-locale reporting. Existing replay and retention controls remain.

## Validation

Complete local source bar passes at `4671e582cfa4bba4809b9e3a354ce5b6eb967f99`. [Commands and results](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/2738c16fa8f75bbd9193105f1cb633729d2d736d/review-evidence/423-r1/corrected-source3/manager). [R251-3 is positive](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/519#issuecomment-5783586279), explicitly resolving F3 and accepting the current five-lens ledger; F1/F2 remain resolved. External R244 and the remaining completion gates are still required.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Complete corrected local source validation and integrity
- [ ] Trusted replica and new exact-head hosted checks
- [ ] Two independent positives and clean reviewer-owned lens ledger
- [ ] Current candidate validation, authorized merge and containment
- [ ] Post-merge hosted results and Closed/Done
title: Prove retained replay across one exact redundant merge
